# 4626.fun

4626.fun is a Base-native creator finance protocol built around ERC-4626 creator vaults.

## What it is
Creators wrap their creator coins into ERC-4626 vaults, enabling fair launches, fee accrual, and DeFi composability on Base.

## Primary topics
- ERC-4626 creator vaults
- EIP-7540 asynchronous vaults
- Creator coin yield and fee compounding
- Base creator economy
- Uniswap Continuous Clearing Auction (CCA)
- LayerZero OFT shares
- Chainlink VRF incentives

## Key links
- Site: https://4626.fun/
- Docs: https://docs.4626.fun/
- Source: https://github.com/4626fun

## Status
Pre-launch. The waitlist accepts creators, allocators, and ecosystem partners.
